selection_process: Preliminary Examination (Objective type) for selection of candidates for Main Examination., Main Examination (Written) and Interview for Personality Test for selection to various services and posts., Preliminary Examination:Two compulsory papers of Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions), General Studies Paper-I (200 marks) and General Studies Paper-II (200 marks), each of 2 hours duration., General Studies Paper-II is a qualifying paper with minimum qualifying marks of 33; selection to Main Examination is based on marks in General Studies Paper-I and qualifying the Paper-II as per rules., There shall be negative marking: for each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question shall be deducted; multiple answers to a question are treated as wrong., Main Examination:Written examination consists of nine papers – two qualifying language papers (Odia and English) in Part-I and seven papers in Part-II (Essay, General Studies-I, II, III, IV and two Optional subject papers)., Marks obtained in Part-II papers and Interview (Personality Test) are counted for ranking; language papers in Part-I are qualifying in nature., Interview (Personality Test) carries 250 marks; final ranking is based on total marks of Main Written and Interview., Candidates are allotted to various Services based on ranks and service preference.

qualification: Diploma/Degree in Mining Engineering, Valid Statutory Certificates, B.A. with Hindi & English, Diploma in Pathology – as per post
selection_process: The Selection methodology will comprise of Computer Based Test (CBT) only. No personal interview will be held., Eligible Candidates, as declared by them, will be provisionally called for Computer Based Test (CBT) on the basis of their declaration regarding their eligibility such as age, educational/technical qualification, Valid Statutory Certificate etc. as laid down in this notification/advertisement., The CBT will comprise of objective type questions with multiple choice of answers and there will beno negative markingfor wrong answers. The instructions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi)., The CBT will consist of two sections i.e. "A" & "B". Section "A" will comprise question specific to General Awareness/Aptitude and will comprise 20 questions of "One" mark each. Section "B" of the test paper will comprise questions relating to Technical knowledge and will comprise 80 questions of "One" mark each, with a total of 100 marks., Qualifying marks (CBT): General/EWS candidates – 45 marks (i.e. 45% of 100); OBC(NCL) candidates – 40 Marks (i.e. 40% of 100); SC/ST candidates – 35 marks (35% of 100)., Based on the merit order of marks secured by the candidates in CBT, the shortlisted qualified candidates in the ratio of 1:3 will be called for document verification., In case of a tie of marks obtained in the CBT, it will be resolved on the basis of Date of Birth (elder one being the first) and thereafter Name alphabets., Successful shortlisted candidates will be notified to appear for scrutiny of their testimonials through the website of MCL. Candidates shall have to appear along with all original certificates/documents & photocopies thereof as per eligibility criteria notified in this advertisement., Those who are working in Govt./Semi Govt./Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/CIL & Subsidiaries etc. must have to produce "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of documents/certificates verification., After verification of documents/certificates, 'Provisional Select List' of successful candidates will be published in the official website of MCL (https://mahanadicoal.in)., Finally, provisionally selected candidates will be issued offer of appointment based on their position in the merit list and with due consideration of the reservation policy of Govt. of India for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS/ESM. They have to undergo Initial Medical Examination (IME) by company's own doctors & their findings thereon will be final. Those who are found UNFIT, will be disqualified for employment., The validity of the merit panel will be for 01 year or as per extant Govt. guidelines., Exact schedule of CBT will be displayed on MCL website (https://mahanadicoal.in) in due course.
